about.p1: Academy started in 2017 with a simple bet: people learn best from practitioners who love teaching. Every course on this platform is reviewed by a human before it goes live, and every instructor is approved — not auto-accepted.
about.p2: We keep classes small in structure — sections, lessons, quizzes — so you always know where you are and what comes next. Progress is tracked lesson by lesson, certificates are issued the moment you finish, and your questions go straight to the instructor.
about.p3: The platform is rebuilt on a modern stack, but the promise is the original one: honest courses, real teachers, visible progress.
